entry.content:
Fillvisa OS v1.5.0 unlocks all supported immigration forms for everyone, adds four new forms, and improves conditional validation in Form I-485.

All forms are now free

Every supported immigration form is now available on Fillvisa Free and Fillvisa OS, including employment-based forms previously exclusive to Fillvisa Plus.

New forms

  • I-129 — Petition for a Nonimmigrant Worker: Prepare employer petitions for temporary workers under classifications including H-1B, L-1, O-1, and others.
  • I-130A — Supplemental Information for Spouse Beneficiary: Provide additional biographical information for a spouse beneficiary of Form I-130.
  • I-129F — Petition for Alien Fiancé(e): Prepare petitions for a foreign national fiancé(e) under the K-1 classification, or a spouse under the K-3 classification in applicable circumstances.
  • I-912 — Request for Fee Waiver: Prepare fee waiver requests directly in your browser, with sections covering means-tested benefits, household income, and financial hardship.

Improved I-485 validation

Updated conditional validation throughout Form I-485 so questions that do not apply to you no longer block form completion or PDF download.

PDF output changes

Removed the hidden meta_formdata field from generated PDFs. This field previously embedded form data as JSON for a planned import feature. Generated PDFs no longer include this embedded data.

entry.content:
We're excited to announce that Form I-912, Request for Fee Waiver, is now available on Fillvisa!

You can prepare your fee waiver request directly in your browser, with sections covering means-tested benefits, household income, and financial hardship.

What’s New?

🟢 Fillvisa Free

  • Complete Form I-912 online without an account or subscription.
  • Follow the sections that apply to your selected fee waiver bases.
  • Save your progress automatically in your browser.
  • Add requestor, interpreter, and preparer signatures using the signature pad.
  • Preview your completed PDF before downloading.
  • Include additional information automatically, with continuation pages generated when needed.

🟢 Fillvisa OS - Open Source

  • Access the I-912 implementation in our open-source project.
  • Self-host and customize it for your own use.

Making Immigration Paperwork More Accessible

Preparing a fee waiver request should not mean paying for form-filling software. With I-912, we’re expanding Fillvisa’s free form library to help people organize their information and prepare their paperwork at their own pace.

Your responses stay in your browser, and you can review the generated PDF before saving it.

Get started: Fill Form I-912 · Fillvisa OS

entry.title: I-485 Update: Smarter Conditional Validation
entry.summary: We’ve improved validation throughout Form I-485 so questions that don’t apply to you no longer block form completion or PDF download. We also tested saved-data restoration, answer changes, and PDF generation to verify the updated behavior
entry.content:
We’ve improved validation throughout Form I-485 so questions that don’t apply to you no longer block form completion or PDF download.

  • Follow-up questions now activate only when the relevant answers make them applicable.
  • Improved handling of spouse information - including separated applicants - marriage history, and child details.
  • Preparer and interpreter sections can remain blank when no assistance was used.
  • Inapplicable answers and explanations are cleared automatically, including outdated saved entries, to keep them out of your PDF.
  • Questions that apply to you remain required.

We also tested saved-data restoration, answer changes, and PDF generation to verify the updated behavior

entry.content:
We're excited to announce that Form I-129F, Petition for Alien Fiancé(e), is now available on Fillvisa Free and Fillvisa OS!

Form I-129F is used by U.S. citizens to petition for their foreign national fiancé(e) to enter the United States for marriage under the K-1 visa classification. It can also be used in certain circumstances to petition for a spouse under the K-3 visa classification.

What's New?

🟢 Fillvisa Free

  • Fill out Form I-129F online, completely free.

  • Save your progress and complete the form at your own pace.

  • Download your completed form as a PDF.

  • No account required, no subscriptions, and no paywalls.

🟢 Fillvisa OS (Open Source)

  • Form I-129F is now included in our open-source project.

  • Self-host, customize, and use it under the AGPL-3.0 license.

  • Available on GitHub.

🔵 Fillvisa Plus - For Immigration Professionals

  • Prepare Form I-129F within your firm's dedicated workspace.

  • Collaborate with staff and clients.

  • Manage petitions, documents, and client information in one place.

Making Family-Based Immigration Forms More Accessible

With the addition of Form I-129F, we're continuing to expand our library of free and open-source immigration forms, helping couples and families navigate the immigration process with accessible, easy-to-use tools.

Whether you're petitioning for your fiancé(e) or preparing applications on behalf of clients, Fillvisa makes it easier to complete immigration forms without expensive software or unnecessary complexity.

Every supported form on Fillvisa is free to use. Fillvisa Plus provides additional workspace and collaboration features for immigration professionals and teams.

entry.content:
We've unlocked all immigration forms on Fillvisa Free and Fillvisa OS, including previously restricted employment-based forms.

Previously, certain immigration forms were exclusively available through Fillvisa Plus. We've now removed those restrictions, making every supported form accessible to everyone, completely free.

What's Changed?

🟢 Fillvisa Free

  • All supported immigration forms are now free, including employment-based forms.

  • Fill out and download completed forms without a subscription.

  • No account required, no paywalls.

🟢 Fillvisa OS (Open Source)

  • All supported forms are now included in our open-source project.

  • Self-host, customize, and build on Fillvisa under the AGPL-3.0 license.

  • Available on GitHub.

🔵 Fillvisa Plus - Now Focused on Teams

Fillvisa Plus is evolving into a dedicated, white-label workspace for immigration professionals, law firms, and agencies.

Instead of charging for access to forms, Plus now focuses on professional workflows, including:

  • Dedicated team workspaces

  • White-label client portals and custom domains

  • Team and client collaboration

  • Reusable client immigration profiles and cross-form autofill

  • Document management and e-signatures

Why This Change?

We believe access to immigration form-filling tools should be free and open.

Going forward, our model is simple:

Free & Open Source = All forms, free for everyone.

Plus = Professional tools for teams and immigration firms.

We'll continue improving our free and open-source offerings while building better collaboration and workflow tools for immigration professionals.

Get started: Fillvisa Free · Fillvisa OS · Fillvisa Plus

Added Form I-539 - Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status Form I-539 is now available in the Fillvisa OS form library. Updated Form I-485 - Application to Register…
entry.content:
We’ve released Fillvisa OS v1.4.0, with updated USCIS forms, a new form in the library, and validation improvements.

What’s new

  • Added Form I-539 - Application to Extend/Change Nonimmigrant Status
    Form I-539 is now available in the Fillvisa OS form library.

  • Updated Form I-485 - Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status
    Form I-485 has been updated to the latest edition.

  • Updated Form I-864 - Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA
    Form I-864 has also been updated to its new edition.

  • Form I-485 validation fixes
    We fixed validation issues affecting several fields in Form I-485 to improve form completion and PDF generation.

As with previous releases, the forms remain available as browser-based web forms that map user-entered data to the official USCIS PDFs.

Fillvisa OS is open source and available on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 license.

Repository:
https://github.com/athos2113/fillvisa-os

entry.content:
We’ve published the latest version of Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, across Fillvisa.

Form I-485 is used by eligible applicants in the United States to apply for lawful permanent resident status (a Green Card). The Fillvisa web form has been updated to match the latest official USCIS form, including the current questions, fields, and PDF structure.

As always, you can fill the form through a browser-friendly interface and generate the completed official USCIS PDF when you’re done.

Official resources:

  • USCIS Form I-485

  • Official Form I-485 PDF

  • Form I-485 Instructions

USCIS periodically revises its forms and filing requirements, so applicants should always verify the current edition and instructions on USCIS before filing.
